basic_details.job_title: GIMS Medical Superintendent Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Government Institute of Medical Sciences (GIMS) has announced 2 vacancies for the Medical Superintendent post on a contract basis. Applicants must possess an MBBS Degree and Post Graduation in Medical Subjects or Hospital Administration from a reputed institute recognized by MCI or NMC, along with 14 years of experience after PG. The notified consolidated pay for the post is Rs. 1,35,000. Eligible candidates can fill the online application form, pay the application fee of Rs. 1,180, and upload required documents online from 1 October 2026 to 30 October 2026. Applicants must also send the print

how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.gims.ac.in from 01.10.2026 onwards to fill out the online application form.
Submit the application fee of Rs. 1180/- (1000+18%GST) online.

Upload required documents online including date of birth certificate as mentioned in Matriculation certificate, certificates of academic qualifications including Mark sheets and Degree from each institution of higher learning attended and official transcripts of each examination passed (If the records are not in English/Hindi, a certificate English/Hindi translation must be provided), complete teaching and other experience certificates, official certification of distinction, prizes, medals etc. received, No Objection Certificate from the present employer, and a declaration that the entries made by you in the application are correct to the best of your knowledge and that nothing has been left out by you intentionally.
Submit the online application by 30 October 2026.

Take a printout of the online filled application form and send it along with self-attested photocopies of all documents including experience certificates by registered or speed post to The Director, Government Institute of Medical Sciences, Kasna, Greater Noida, Gautam Buddha Nagar, UP (India)-201310, by 7th November 2026 till 5:00 PM. Advertisement number and name of the post should be mentioned at the top of the envelope.
important_instructions: Applicants are considered only for appointment on a contractual basis. Incomplete applications will not be considered and will be treated as cancelled. Advance applications will be accepted, but a copy forwarded through proper channel or a "No objection certificate" from the current employer must be submitted on or before the date of interview. The number of posts indicated is provisional and subject to change without prior notice. The Director, Government Institute of Medical Sciences, Kasna, Greater Noida reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reason thereof. For any query kindly contact- 9899370360, 9999384468. Application form is available at the Institute website (http://www.gims.ac.in) Copy of the completed form should be sent, with copies of proofs of education/academic qualifications, experience, testimonials etc, as indicated therein. All disputes will be subjected to the jurisdiction of the Hon’ble High Court of Judicature at Allahabad, UP.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Superintendent post?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available, both under the Unreserved (UR) category.
